metadata.title: Part II Utilization and Bottleneck Analysis
metadata.description: Consolidated stage-level, source-level, bubble, and prefill PM results for the SF-MLA paper Part II.
notes: Part I uses DeepSeek FlashMLA as the decode primary method; Part II dense decode characterization remains TT-mainline mechanism proxy
decode_256~8k uses batch=2; decode_16k/32k uses batch=1
decode bubble metrics are interpreted as accumulated stall density, not wall-time share
prefill direct PM util is taken from sync_extra + repr_sync runs
